guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設完全混合固定V=1000000m³、淡水Q=100m³/s、無再入鹽，C由5降1kg/m³，t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δρ=20、參考ρ=1000kg/m³，g′=0.1962m/s²；兩層厚4與6m，c=√[g′h1h2/(h1+h2)]=0.6862m/s。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設g′=0.1962m/s²、層尺度H=2m、速度差ΔU=0.50m/s，Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696；非局部穩定門檻。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed volume1000000m³,box concentration2kg/m³,equal flows100m³/s and input5kg/m³. Storage=2000000kg; instantaneous dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s).

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a fixed mixed box1000000m³,fresh inflow100m³/s and no renewed salt input. Falling5to1kg/m³ takes t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume density contrast20kg/m³,reference1000kg/m³,g′=0.1962m/s² and layers4and6m. Rigid-lid long-wave speed c=0.6862m/s.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume g′=0.1962m/s²,layer scale2m and velocity difference0.50m/s. Bulk Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696, not a local stability threshold.
timeline: 1991　工兵團發布潮汐水理方法手冊
2023　密西西比河低水事件期間施工阻鹽門檻
2025　荷蘭主管機關回報鹽壩排水影響超預期
timelineEn: 1991 — USACE publishes its tidal-hydraulics methodology manual
2023 — A salt-control sill is constructed during Mississippi low-water conditions
2025 — The Dutch authority reports greater-than-expected drainage effects from the salt barrier
codes: 潮汐水理EM1110-2-1607，一九九一年方法背景
現地水質手冊A6.3比電導，二〇一九年
codesEn: National Field Manual A6.3 Specific Conductance,2019
landmarks: 密西西比河水下門檻：鹽楔延緩
艾默伊登鹽壩：選擇性排鹽與排水互制
landmarksEn: IJmuiden salt barrier: salt export and drainage interaction
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：河口鹽水入侵控制
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries
guides.concept: 用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
guides.conceptEn: Evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
procedure: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。穩態完全混合模型以入流鹽質量守恆求出口濃度，但真實河口常有底層鹽楔及潮汐逆流；平均濃度不能描述取水口所在深度的短時暴露。 假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。
鹽通量是流速與濃度在斷面的共同積分，漲退潮方向和分層會讓兩者呈現相關性。平均濃度乘淨流量只適用均勻或明定近似，零淨水量也可能有非零淨鹽輸送；因此要同時觀測水流與鹽分，不能只靠一支鹽度儀解讀入侵。 假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。
控制體內鹽庫存等於體積乘平均質量濃度，但當濃度和水量都變動時需完整微分。固定容積完全混合箱可由入出鹽通量算瞬時濃度變率，之後出口濃度也跟著變化；不能把初始變率長時間線性外推，或將觀測殘差全部歸為感測錯誤。 假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。
沖淡速度取決於有效混合容積和交換路徑，完全混合箱會呈指數下降而不是每段時間去除固定鹽量。實際河口有死水區、再入侵和潮汐交換，單一停留尺度不能代表所有水團年齡；計算結果應是比較假設的基準，不是實際供水恢復時間保證。 假設完全混合固定V=1000000m³、淡水Q=100m³/s、無再入鹽，C由5降1kg/m³，t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h。
淡鹹水密度差使界面能支持內波，其速度遠小於自由表面重力波且受上下層厚度控制。兩層淺水、剛蓋與小振幅模型只適合辨識尺度，不含剪切、摩擦及界面厚度；將它套到完全混合河段會失去物理意義，應先用量測確認垂向分層存在。 假設Δρ=20、參考ρ=1000kg/m³，g′=0.1962m/s²；兩層厚4與6m，c=√[g′h1h2/(h1+h2)]=0.6862m/s。
密度分層抵抗垂向混合，速度剪切提供擾動能量，體積理查森數可整理兩者量級。它不同於局部梯度理查森數，不能直接沿用理想線性穩定門檻，真實河口還有潮汐歷史及邊界混合；比值用來比較狀態，不是無紊流或零混合證明。 假設g′=0.1962m/s²、層尺度H=2m、速度差ΔU=0.50m/s，Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696；非局部穩定門檻。
潮汐流量正負交替，大量水體可往返交換而淨水量很小，這與潮混合輸鹽是不同統計量。正弦半週積分提供單向交換體積，不能當淡水沖洗量或新水替換量；被送出的水可能下一潮返回，因此水團追蹤與濃度仍不可省略。 假設Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s、T=43200s，正半週交換V=QmaxT/π=6875494m³，整週淨水量0。
底層較鹹時，選擇性取排可在同樣水量中帶走更多鹽，但混入淡水、界面吸升和潮向會改變效果。鹽通量比較只是局部效率，不代表整個水系供水、排洪和生態都改善；設施造成的阻力與新的運轉限制必須放入同一評估。 假設同樣Q=10m³/s，底層C=20與混合水C=5kg/m³，排鹽200與50kg/s，局部比例4；不含回流和排水限制。
阻鹽門檻或選擇性通道會改變水力連通，減少鹽入侵的同時可能增加排水水頭損失。固定局部係數僅示意速度平方關係，實際流場會受密度、開口與泵站互制影響；因此設計與驗證不能把排鹽和防洪各自視為完全獨立的系統。 假設局部係數K=2、參考速度1.5m/s，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m；是合成清水基準，非艾默伊登量測。
電導轉鹽分需要溫度補償及適用關係，儀器漂移、生物附著與不同離子組成會影響結果。兩個數值相減只能指出與參考的差，不能自動決定哪一支錯；校正、獨立採樣和不確定度應共同支持控制判斷，避免把單點偏差誤認為鹽楔突然移動。 假設同樣本換算質量濃度感測3.20kg/m³、可追溯參考3.00kg/m³，偏差+0.20kg/m³、相對+6.667%；不代表水體變鹹。
procedureEn: Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. A steady completely mixed balance equates incoming and outgoing salt mass, whereas real estuaries may contain a bottom wedge and reversing tides. Mean concentration therefore cannot describe short-term exposure at a particular intake depth or establish a spatial intrusion boundary by itself. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.

Salt flux integrates velocity times concentration across a section. Tidal direction and stratification correlate these variables, so mean concentration times net discharge is valid only under a stated approximation. Zero net water exchange can still produce net salt transport. Simultaneous flow and concentration observations are therefore essential; one salinity sensor cannot independently reveal the full direction or magnitude of intrusion. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC.

Salt storage is volume times mean mass concentration, requiring a full derivative if both change. A constant-volume mixed box converts net salt flux into an instantaneous concentration rate, but outlet concentration then evolves with the box. The initial rate cannot be extrapolated linearly indefinitely, and unexplained residuals may represent omitted pathways or mixing structure rather than only sensor error. Assume fixed volume1000000m³,box concentration2kg/m³,equal flows100m³/s and input5kg/m³. Storage=2000000kg; instantaneous dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s).

Flushing depends on effective mixing volume and exchange pathways. A completely mixed box declines exponentially rather than losing a fixed salt mass each interval. Dead zones, renewed intrusion and tidal exchange create multiple residence times in an estuary, so one scale does not describe every parcel age. The calculation compares assumptions rather than guaranteeing when an actual water supply will recover. Assume a fixed mixed box1000000m³,fresh inflow100m³/s and no renewed salt input. Falling5to1kg/m³ takes t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h.

A density contrast supports internal waves with speeds much lower than free-surface waves and dependent on both layer thicknesses. A two-layer shallow-water rigid-lid small-amplitude model identifies a scale only, excluding shear, friction and finite interface thickness. Applying it to a well-mixed reach is physically inappropriate, so observed stratification must first justify the assumed two-layer representation. Assume density contrast20kg/m³,reference1000kg/m³,g′=0.1962m/s² and layers4and6m. Rigid-lid long-wave speed c=0.6862m/s.

Stratification resists vertical exchange while shear supplies disturbance energy. A bulk Richardson number organizes their scales but differs from a local gradient Richardson number, so an ideal linear-stability threshold cannot be transferred directly. Tidal history and boundary mixing also matter. The ratio compares states rather than proving that turbulence or salt mixing is absent from the river or estuary. Assume g′=0.1962m/s²,layer scale2m and velocity difference0.50m/s. Bulk Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696, not a local stability threshold.

Tidal discharge alternates sign, allowing large gross exchange with small net volume. This is statistically distinct from tide-driven salt transport. Integrating one positive sinusoidal half-cycle gives one-way exchanged volume, not freshwater flushing or completely new water. Exported parcels may return on the next tide, so concentration and parcel tracking remain necessary for interpreting the effective exchange of salt. Assume Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s with T=43200s. Positive half-cycle volume QmaxT/π=6875494m³; full-cycle net volume is0.

Preferential bottom withdrawal can export more salt per unit water where stratification persists, but freshwater entrainment, interface draw-up and tide alter effectiveness. Comparing salt flux is only a local efficiency measure, not proof of better water supply, drainage and ecology across the system. Added resistance and operational constraints must be assessed alongside the intended selective-export benefit. Assume equal withdrawal10m³/s from bottom concentration20 or mixed5kg/m³. Salt export is200versus50kg/s, ratio4, excluding return flow and drainage constraints.

A sill or selective channel changes hydraulic connectivity and can add drainage loss while addressing salt intrusion. A fixed local coefficient illustrates velocity-squared behavior only; density, openings and pumping interact in the real flow. Design and verification therefore cannot treat salt control and flood drainage as fully independent systems whose local successes automatically combine into successful overall performance. Assume K=2 and reference speed1.5m/s. hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m is a synthetic clear-water baseline, not an IJmuiden measurement.

Conductance-to-salt conversion requires temperature compensation and an appropriate relationship; drift, fouling and different ionic composition affect the result. Comparing two readings identifies a discrepancy but does not automatically show which is wrong. Calibration, independent samples and uncertainty must jointly support decisions so a biased point measurement is not mistaken for sudden movement of the salt wedge. Assume the same sample gives converted3.20kg/m³ versus traceable reference3.00kg/m³. Bias is+0.20kg/m³ or+6.667%, not evidence of environmental salinization.
evidence: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。
將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。比較平均乘積與乘積平均的差異，標示未量區和外推方式，不以淨流量代替雙向交換。
將容積變化與鹽濃度變化分開核對，確認進出流是否真的平衡，按每個時間步更新出口濃度。以獨立剖面估庫存，保存未閉合收支並調查漏掉的側支流、底層或地下水交換。
用時間序列檢查對數濃度是否近似線性，辨識淡水入口、出口與滯留區，核對有無潮汐再入。比較不同深度下降速率並報告模型殘差，不能用單點達標時間推定全部水體完成置換。
量測溫鹽密度剖面並確認界面和層厚，明列長波與剛蓋假設，核對背景剪切流。將界面移動時序與估計速度比較，保留界面模糊或完全混合的時段，不強行維持兩層參數。
evidenceEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.

Measure velocity and concentration by section cell with direction and tidal phase, integrating before cycle averaging. Compare product-of-means with mean-product results, documenting unmeasured areas and extrapolation instead of replacing two-way exchange by net water flow alone.

Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep. Estimate storage independently from profiles, retaining residuals while investigating missing tributaries, lower-layer exchange or groundwater rather than forcing numerical closure.

Check whether log concentration is approximately linear through time, locating inlet, outlet and stagnant zones and testing tidal re-entry. Compare decline at different depths and report residuals instead of using one sensor's threshold time to declare complete replacement of the water body.

Measure temperature-salinity density profiles to identify interface and layer depths, stating long-wave and rigid-lid assumptions and checking shear. Compare interface timing with the estimate, retaining blurred-interface or fully mixed periods rather than forcing a two-layer parameterization through all conditions.
pitfalls: 僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。即使整體平均降低，局部取水點仍可能遇到短暫高濃度水團。
忽略水位變化會把稀釋誤認為鹽移除，固定使用初始出口濃度又累積不守恆誤差。未量到底層高鹽庫存時，即使表層感測穩定也不能宣告整體庫存不變。
表層鹽度低不代表底層密度差固定，風混合可使界面消失。若仍用相同內波速度預測鹽楔回應，會錯估通量調整與感測器間訊號延遲。
只取半潮資料會把單向交換誤當淨流入，端點相位偏差也可製造假淨量。交換量很大但回流水比例高時，污染或鹽分的真正排出仍可能緩慢。
枯水排鹽測試成功不能代表暴雨排洪不受影響，新增阻力可能使上游水位更難下降。若只在單一流量驗證，非線性損失在較大流量時會被低估。
pitfallsEn: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. Even a falling system mean can coexist with a brief high-concentration water mass reaching a particular intake.

Ignoring changing volume confuses dilution with salt removal, while retaining initial outlet concentration accumulates nonconservative error. An unseen saline lower-layer reservoir can change even when surface sensors appear stable, invalidating a whole-estuary storage conclusion.

Low surface salinity does not imply a fixed density contrast below, and wind mixing can erase the interface. Retaining the same internal-wave speed then misstates transport adjustment and the expected lag between monitoring stations.

Using only half a tide mistakes one-way exchange for net inflow, and endpoint phase error creates a false residual. Even large exchange may remove salt or contaminants slowly when a high fraction of exported water returns.

Successful low-flow salt-export testing does not prove unaffected storm drainage; added resistance can slow upstream drawdown. Verification at one discharge may also understate nonlinear losses when substantially larger volumes must pass through the same constrained opening.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Complete mixing and salt balance” and “Effective chamber water volume”.

history.title: 河口鹽水入侵控制
history.text: 河口阻鹽不是單一擋牆問題，淡水流量、潮汐交換、分層與排水功能都會互相影響。一九九一年潮汐水理手冊提供方法背景，二〇一九年美國地質調查局電導章節則強調量測品質。二〇二三年密西西比河低水期間的水下門檻是延緩鹽楔的場址措施，不能改寫成永久消除入侵。艾默伊登主管機關於二〇二五年四月回報，前一年末進入測試的鹽壩對排水影響大於預期，正說明功能互制必須經實測查核。本課合成數據分別練習守恆、分層和損失，不把局部排鹽效率當成整體成效保證。
history.textEn: Estuary salt control is not simply a barrier problem: freshwater flow, tidal exchange, stratification and drainage interact. The1991 tidal manual supplies methodology, while USGS’s2019 conductance chapter emphasizes measurement quality. The2023 Mississippi sill is a site intervention to delay a salt wedge, not permanent elimination of intrusion. In April2025 the IJmuiden authority reported greater-than-expected drainage effects during testing that began late the previous year, demonstrating why coupled functions require observations. Synthetic examples separately examine conservation, stratification and losses; local salt-export efficiency is not presented as a guarantee of successful whole-system performance.

references.title: 潮汐水理手冊
references.scope: 官方書目列一九九一年三月潮汐水理方法；提供歷史方法背景，不當作特定河口操作規則。
references.scopeEn: Official catalogue lists March1991 tidal-hydraulics methods; historical methodology is not a site-specific estuary operating rule.

references.title: 水質現地比電導量測指引
references.titleEn: National Field Manual A6.3 Specific Conductance
references.scope: 官方二〇一九年章節涵蓋校正、量測及報告；電導與鹽質量濃度需適用轉換，不是同一物理量。
references.scopeEn: The2019 official chapter covers calibration, measurement and reporting; conductance and salt mass concentration require an applicable conversion and are not the same quantity.

references.title: 密西西比河阻鹽水下門檻
references.scope: 官方二〇二三年七月紀錄水下門檻與歷次低水年措施；是延緩鹽楔的場址工作，不是永久消除鹽入侵承諾。
references.scopeEn: July2023 authority record describes a sill and prior low-flow interventions; this site measure delays salt-wedge progression, not permanent elimination of intrusion.

references.title: 艾默伊登選擇性排鹽工程
references.titleEn: Selective Withdrawal at IJmuiden Sea Lock
references.scope: 已開啟主管機關專案頁，說明底部排出較鹹水的目的；需與二〇二五年排水限制回報合讀。
references.scopeEn: Opened project page explains preferential bottom saltwater export; it must be read together with the2025 report of drainage constraints.

references.title: 艾默伊登鹽壩非預期排水影響
references.titleEn: Unexpected effects of IJmuiden salt barrier
references.scope: 二〇二五年四月官方回報試驗發現排水受影響大於預期；用作功能互制與驗證案例，不只宣傳排鹽效益。
references.scopeEn: April2025 authority report says testing found drainage effects larger than expected; used to examine coupled functions and verification, not only advertised salt-export benefits.
